description: Capability for the main window. Permission boundary note (M11): clipboard-manager:allow-read-text deliberately grants the main webview persistent clipboard READ access (including while the vault is locked). This is an explicit minimal-privilege expansion required by the clipboard auto-clear digest guard; it is accepted because the CSP is 'self'-only (no remote content can invoke the bridge) and src/utils/clipboard.ts only clears after verifying a SHA-256 digest match. M12 (v1.1.9, audit SEC-M2): the static $HOME/$TEMP/$Volumes fs write/read/stat grants were revoked — all backup/restore and recovery-key file IO goes through dedicated desktop commands (export_vault_file, read_backup_file, enable_recovery), so the webview holds no path-based fs capability beyond fs:default.
